author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Innovation: LSS + DAQB
abstract: This experiment tests a novel combination of components. It replaces the PBVE-lite (Ridge Regression) correction in the community SOTA pipeline with my own, higher-performing "Latent Space Batch Standardization" (LSS) method. The pipeline is `log1p -> scale -> PCA -> LSS -> DAQB`. The hypothesis is that the LSS-corrected latent space will provide a superior input for the DAQB graph construction, leading to a synergistic improvement in overall score.
